title: Finite filtered additive categories and bounded-below filtered localization
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and use the decreasing filtrations, filtration-preserving maps, finite-filtration predicate and graded quotients of [def-sp-filtration]. The canonical restrictions and graded maps are those of [lem-sp-finite-filtration-induction]; graded complexes have the quotient meaning of [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. For an optional integer interval $B$, let $\mathcal C_B$ be the full subcategory of finite filtered objects, restricted to $F^aX=X$, $F^{b+1}X=0$ when $B=[a,b]$, and unrestricted when no interval is supplied. Let $\mathcal I_B$ be its full subcategory whose graded objects are injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Addition of filtered maps is the underlying addition; these categories have finite products given by finite direct sums with the direct-sum filtration, hence zero objects and finite biproducts. The inclusions, forgetful functor $e_\varnothing$, and graded functors $e_p$ are additive; graded maps are the canonical cokernel maps and preserve identities and composition. Put $K_B^+=K^+(\mathcal C_B)$ and $K_{I,B}^+=K^+(\mathcal I_B)$, using bounded-below integer-indexed complexes modulo chain homotopies valued in the filtered category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with their standard cone triangulations [def-weil-triangulated-category]. No uniform filtration interval is imposed across cochain degrees unless $B$ is supplied. Let $W_B$ be the maps inducing ordinary quasi-isomorphisms on every graded complex. These form a class admitting a left calculus of fractions and compatible with shifts and cone triangles. Define $DF_B^+=K_B^+[W_B^{-1}]$ by formal category localization, with its induced triangulation, $Q_B:K_B^+\to DF_B^+$ its canonical functor, and $c_B:K_{I,B}^+\to DF_B^+$ inclusion followed by $Q_B$, with the induced shift comparison. For any chosen ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], forgetting and grading followed by $K^+(\mathcal A)\to D^+(\mathcal A)$ invert $W_B$. Define $e_p^D:DF_B^+\to D^+(\mathcal A)$ as their canonical localization lifts, including $p=\varnothing$ for forgetting.
